description: Calculate body fat percentage using the US Navy circumference method. See list_bundles for related 'sante' calculators.

hip_cm.description: Hip circumference in cm (widest point, required for females)

waist_cm.description: Waist circumference in cm (at navel for males, narrowest for females)

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kg (default 70kg for fat mass calculation)

name: calculate_body_fat_navy

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").

title: Calculate Body Fat Navy
